Nvidia Blackwell Chips Turn Up at China Site Tied to Alice Huang
videos.description: A pair of Chinese firms installed Nvidia Corp.’s powerful Blackwell semiconductors in a Shanghai data center linked to Alice Huang, the woman at the heart of a controversy surrounding the US chipmaker. The gear installed at the Yangtze River Delta Project included a GB300 NVL72 rack, among Nvidia’s most powerful products, according to a serial number specified in documents submitted to Chinese regulators in November. Shanghai Shuoyao offered the hardware as collateral to obtain a 96 million yuan ($14 million) loan from Shanghai Innovation Bank, according to filings from the lender that were reviewed by Bloomberg News. Bloomberg's Tom Keene and Paul Sweeney get details from Olivia Levieux, Markets Strategist with Bloomberg News -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video? videos.title: Underlying AI Demand 'Much Bigger' than Market Pricing In, Says Ives
videos.description: The Nasdaq 100 Index plunged for a second day, sending it careening into bear-market territory as traders dumped technology shares, with worries around AI dominating sentiment on Wall Street. Dan Ives, Partner at Yorkville Ives & Co, discusses the continued pullback in tech and what 2027 will bring to the world of AI investment. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video?
